legs.label: Translate the search prior
legs.description: Turn an optional four-section product description into a confidence-tagged search prior.
legs.lead: A head start for the source read — leads to confirm, never answers to trust.
beats: If no description was supplied, writes nothing and proceeds source-only.
Reads only the four sections and emits leads — actors, vocabulary, unit, path, state, places, shape — each with a confidence and open questions for every guess.
Treats the result as a suspect lineup: positive leads widen the search, only a high-confidence fence entry prunes.

legs.label: Survey the source
legs.description: Read the manifest and scope, then pick the ~25–35 files worth reading, in order.
legs.lead: The manifest is the read boundary; scope is the filing boundary.
beats: Records the in-scope and out-of-scope roots and topics before choosing a single read.
Walks the file tree paths-only and orders a tier-1 / tier-2 / tier-3 read ladder, capped at 25–35 files.
Refuses loudly with a refusal report when the manifest points at nothing scannable.

legs.label: Surface the events
legs.description: Walk the product's history as a time-ordered list of past-tense domain events.
legs.lead: Time-first: the timeline is the central record's lifecycle.
beats: Reads tier-1, then tier-2, then a tier-3 language sample.
Names the central record and, for each event, its trigger, where it lands, and the state it lands in.
Marks Hot Spots inline where the sources disagree — the primary diagnostic value.

legs.label: Carve the contexts
legs.description: Carve bounded contexts where the language changes and classify each noun.
legs.lead: A context boundary lands where the vocabulary shifts.
beats: Suspends substantive out-of-scope or borderline piles as suspects — no folders, no cards.
Classifies each in-scope noun into a canonical category, keeping the architect's word as the label.
Proposes demotions and splits as Hot Spots rather than silently deleting or picking.

legs.label: Tag the altitudes
legs.description: Tag each carded noun's zoom level so the bundle keeps one level per card.
legs.lead: One altitude per card; never mix levels.
beats: Assigns pillar / context / aggregate / component / value / capability per card.
Adds a rationale only where the call is non-obvious.
Marks a Hot Spot naming both candidates when two altitudes are equally honest.

legs.label: Write the bundle
legs.description: Write the cards, the _index keystone story, the reports, and the JSON sidecars to disk.
legs.lead: The body names the product; the frontmatter holds the machine.
beats: Writes one product-English stub card per in-scope noun and the keystone story that names all and only the card-bearing containers.
Emits workflows.json, records Ledger thread openings with notepad provenance, and writes the three reports.
Writes every file with its tools — a reply that names files but writes none is a failed run.

legs.label: Cold-read and decide
legs.description: Read the bundle blind and decide PASS, REPAIR, or FREEZE.
legs.lead: A stranger's read — no prior-stage summary contaminates it.
beats: Runs the keystone and machine-language gates before PASS.
Checks typed-link targets, the Small floor, thread provenance, and work-thread coverage.
Bounces REPAIR back to the write step, freezes an unsalvageable bundle, or passes a coherent one.
